rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and visible dense ICM, but it overstates certainty about hatching/hernation and TE uniformity from this single image and adds non-visible details such as clear herniation site and absence of degeneration.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS phenotype, prior cycle, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and transfer timing with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates broadly following the presented factors, though some claims are stronger than the image/data support and a few adjustments are somewhat speculative.

Much of the assessment aligns with standard IVF practice, but recommendations such as ERA after only two failed transfers, routine thrombophilia testing, growth hormone/DHEA, metformin in lean PCOS, and EmbryoGlue are not strongly guideline-supported for this scenario.
Provides clear practical suggestions for transfer management and contingency planning, though several recommendations are more optional or controversial than standard-of-care.
